question: They stayed in _____ hotel near the beach and visited _____ museum in the evening.
hint: Pehli baar kisi singular countable noun ka zikr ho toh 'a/an' lagta hai, aur kisi khaas jagah ke liye 'the' lagta hai.
explanation: 'Hotel' consonant sound ('h') se shuru hota hai isliye 'a' lagega, aur 'museum' ek specific jagah ke roop me refer ho raha hai isliye 'the' aayega.

question: I have a car. _____ car is very comfortable.
hint: Jab kisi noun ka zikr pehle ho chuka ho aur dobara usi ki baat ho, toh kaunsa article lagta hai?
explanation: Pehle sentence me 'a car' ka zikr ho chuka hai, isliye doosre sentence me usi definite car ke liye 'The' ka use hoga.

question: _____ umbrella is _____ useful thing.
hint: Article lagate waqt spelling nahi balki shabd ki shuruati sound (vowel ya consonant) dekhein.
explanation: 'Umbrella' vowel sound ('अ') se shuru hota hai isliye 'An' lagega, jabki 'useful' consonant sound ('य') se shuru hota hai isliye 'a' aayega.

question: How did you like living on _____ island for six months?
hint: 'Island' shabd ke uchcharan (pronunciation) ki pehli sound par dhyan dein.
explanation: 'Island' ka uchcharan vowel sound ('आ') se shuru hota hai, isliye isse pehle indefinite article 'an' ka use hoga.

question: They are watching _____ movie.
hint: 'Movie' ek singular countable noun hai jo consonant sound se shuru hota hai.
explanation: 'Movie' consonant sound ('म') se shuru hone wala singular noun hai, isliye yahan 'a' lagega.

question: Mount Everest is _____ highest peak in the world.
hint: Superlative degree (jaise highest, tallest, best) se pehle hamesha kaunsa article lagta hai?
explanation: 'Highest' adjective ki superlative degree hai, aur superlative degree se pehle hamesha definite article 'the' ka use hota hai.

question: He gave me _____ one rupee note.
hint: 'One' ki spelling 'O' se shuru hoti hai, lekin iska uchcharan 'व' (consonant sound) se hota hai.
explanation: 'One' ka uchcharan 'वन' ('व' consonant sound) se shuru hota hai, isliye 'an' ki jagah 'a' ka use sahi hai.

question: She is _____ M.A. in English. / Mohit is _____ M.Sc. student.
hint: Abbreviations (M.A., M.Sc.) ko bolte waqt pehle akshar 'M' ka uchcharan 'एम' (vowel sound) se hota hai.
explanation: 'M.A.' aur 'M.Sc.' ka uchcharan vowel sound ('ए') se shuru hota hai, isliye dono jagah 'an' ka use hoga.

question: Have they _____ complaint against you? / Do you have _____ money / apples?
hint: Interrogative (prashnvachak) aur negative sentences me aam taur par kaunsa determiner use hota hai?
explanation: Sawal puchhne wale (interrogative) sentences me 'some' ki jagah 'any' ka use kiya jata hai.

question: There are _____ chairs in the classroom, so please bring some more.
hint: 'Chairs' ek plural countable noun hai, isliye countable ke liye use hone wala determiner chunein.
explanation: 'Chairs' countable noun hai isliye 'few' (bahut kam) ka use hoga; 'little' aur 'much' uncountable nouns ke saath lagte hain.

question: The school library has _____ books on Psychology.
hint: 'Books' ko gina ja sakta hai (countable noun), isliye sankhya batane wala determiner lagayein.
explanation: 'Books' plural countable noun hai, isliye iske saath 'few' ka use hoga ('little' aur 'much' uncountable ke liye aate hain).

question: Rajiv has _____ books in his own library.
hint: 'Books' plural countable noun hai; zyada sankhya dikhane ke liye kaunsa shabd aayega?
explanation: Countable plural nouns (jaise 'books') ki adhik sankhya batane ke liye 'many' ka use hota hai, jabki 'much' uncountable ke liye lagta hai.

question: How _____ experience have you got?
hint: 'Experience' (anubhav) ek uncountable noun hai, ise 1, 2, 3 karke nahi gina ja sakta.
explanation: 'Experience' uncountable noun hai, isliye matra (quantity) puchhne ke liye 'How much' ka use hoga.

question: There is _____ water in the bottle.
hint: 'Water' ek uncountable noun hai aur sentence affirmative (sakaratmak) hai.
explanation: 'Water' uncountable noun hai isliye 'many' ya 'few' nahi lagega, aur positive sentence hone ke karan 'much' sahi hai.

question: _____ the people were shouting loudly.
hint: Plural noun ('the people') aur plural verb ('were') ke saath kaunsa determiner sahi baithta hai?
explanation: 'All' ke baad 'the + plural noun' (All the people) ka use hota hai, jabki 'Every' aur 'Each' singular ke saath lagte hain.

question: The traffic rules _____ be followed.
hint: Kanoon aur traffic rules ka palan karna ek anivarya (compulsory) kartavya hai.
explanation: Strict obligation ya anivarya niyam (traffic rules) dikhane ke liye modal 'must' ka use kiya jata hai.

question: You _____ wear a helmet while riding a two-wheeler.
hint: Two-wheeler chalate waqt helmet pehenna suraksha aur kanoon dono ke hisab se zaroori (compulsory) hai.
explanation: Strong compulsion aur safety rule dikhane ke liye 'must' ka use sabse upyukt hai.

question: I _____ speak English fluently.
hint: Present tense me kisi kaam ko karne ki kshamta (ability) dikhane ke liye kaunsa modal lagta hai?
explanation: Vartaman samay ki yogyata ya ability (English bolne ki kshamta) dikhane ke liye 'can' ka use hota hai.

question: We _____ to respect our elders.
hint: Blank ke turant baad 'to' laga hua hai; kis modal ke saath hamesha 'to' aata hai?
explanation: 'Ought' ek aisa modal hai jiske baad 'to' (ought to) ka use hota hai, jabki 'must' aur 'should' ke baad seedha V1 lagta hai.

question: Hari / Rajat _____ run fast when he was young.
hint: Sentence ke aakhir me 'when he was young' likha hai, jo past tense (bhootkaal) dikhata hai.
explanation: Past tense ki ability (jawani me tez daudne ki kshamta) dikhane ke liye 'can' ke past form 'could' ka use hota hai.

question: Keep / Place your books / the pen _____ the table.
hint: Kisi satah (surface) ke upar koi cheez rakhi ho toh kaunsa preposition lagta hai?
explanation: Table ki upari satah (surface) par koi cheez rakhne ke liye preposition 'on' ka use hota hai.

question: Place the pen _____ the table.
hint: Options me 'on' nahi hai; uski jagah satah par rakhne ke liye kaunsa preposition diya gaya hai?
explanation: Diye gaye options me 'upon' ka use table ki satah ke upar pen rakhne (movement onto a surface) ke liye sahi hai.

question: He was born _____ Mumbai.
hint: Bade shahron, rajyon ya deshon ke naam se pehle kaunsa preposition lagta hai?
explanation: Mumbai ek bada shahar hai, aur bade sthanon ke naam se pehle preposition 'in' ka use kiya jata hai.

question: They have been playing cricket _____ morning.
hint: 'Morning' ek nishchit samay (point of time) hai, avadhi (duration) nahi.
explanation: Present Perfect Continuous tense me nishchit samay (point of time, jaise morning) se pehle 'since' ka use hota hai.

question: Ravi is much elder _____ me.
hint: 'Older' ke saath 'than' lagta hai, lekin 'elder' ke saath hamesha ek fixed preposition aata hai.
explanation: 'Elder' ke baad tulna dikhane ke liye 'than' ki jagah hamesha preposition 'to' (elder to) ka use hota hai.

question: I know you are afraid _____ dogs.
hint: 'Afraid' (darna) shabd ke saath hamesha ek fixed preposition lagta hai.
explanation: Kisi cheez se darne ke arth me 'afraid' ke baad hamesha preposition 'of' (afraid of) ka use kiya jata hai.

question: The cat jumped _____ the rat.
hint: Jab koi cheez gati (motion) ke saath kisi ke upar koodti hai toh kaunsa preposition lagta hai?
explanation: Gati ke saath kisi ke upar koodne ya jhapatne (motion) ko dikhane ke liye 'upon' ka use hota hai.

question: The ball passed _____ his head.
hint: Gend uske sar ko chhue bina upar se guzar gayi.
explanation: Kisi cheez ke upar se bina sparsh (touch) kiye guzarne ke liye preposition 'over' ka use hota hai.

question: He jumped _____ the river.
hint: Bahar se andar ki taraf gati (motion) dikhane ke liye kaunsa preposition lagta hai?
explanation: Nadi ke bahar se andar koodne ki gati (movement from outside to inside) dikhane ke liye 'into' ka use hota hai.

question: Suresh is writing _____ a pencil.
hint: Kisi auzar ya sadhan (instrument, jaise pen ya pencil) se kaam karne par kaunsa preposition lagta hai?
explanation: Pencil ya pen jaise kisi instrument ke madhyam se likhne ke liye preposition 'with' ka use hota hai.

question: He always _____ his homework before dinner.
hint: 'Always' aadat (habit) dikhata hai, aur subject 'He' third-person singular hai.
explanation: Present Indefinite tense me singular subject ('He') ke saath verb ki first form me 'es' lagkar 'does' banta hai.

question: The milkman _____ milk daily in the evening.
hint: 'Daily' rozana ki aadat dikhata hai aur 'The milkman' ek singular subject hai.
explanation: Simple Present tense me singular subject ('The milkman') ke saath verb me 's' lagkar 'brings' ka use hoga.

question: He usually _____ in Hindi / English.
hint: 'Usually' aksar hone wali aadat batata hai aur subject 'He' singular hai.
explanation: Present Indefinite tense me third-person singular subject ('He') ke saath 'speaks' ka use hota hai.

question: English / Hindi is _____ in many countries.
hint: Yeh sentence Passive Voice me hai ('is + V3').
explanation: Passive voice structure (is/am/are + V3) ke anusaar 'is' ke baad 'speak' ki third form 'spoken' aayegi.

question: The chair is _____ by her.
hint: Sentence me 'is _____ by her' diya hai, jo Passive Voice hai aur isme V3 lagti hai.
explanation: Passive voice me 'is' ke baad verb ki third form (past participle) 'broken' ka use hota hai.

question: No other fruit is as _____ as mango.
hint: 'as ... as' ke beech mein hamesha adjective ki Positive Degree aati hai.
explanation: 'as _____ as' structure me tulna ke liye adjective ki positive degree ('sweet') ka use kiya jata hai.

question: This is the girl _____ won the first prize in singing.
hint: Blank se pehle vyakti ('the girl') hai aur blank ke turant baad verb ('won') aayi hai.
explanation: Kisi vyakti (person) ko subject ke roop me jodne ke liye relative pronoun 'who' ka use hota hai.

question: This is the man _____ presided the meeting.
hint: Blank se pehle 'the man' (person) hai aur baad me verb 'presided' hai.
explanation: Vyakti ('the man') ke liye subjective relative pronoun 'who' ka use kiya jata hai.

question: This is the boy _____ name is written on the board.
hint: Yahan ladke ka naam ('jiska naam') yaani adhikar/sambandh (possession) dikhaya ja raha hai.
explanation: Possession (jiska/jiski) dikhane ke liye relative pronoun 'whose' ka use hota hai.

question: The man _____ the police arrested last night lives near my building.
hint: Yahan 'the man' arrest hone ka object hai ('jise police ne pakda').
explanation: Jab vyakti ('the man') verb ka object ho ('jise'), tab objective relative pronoun 'whom' ka use hota hai.

question: The train was late _____ the weather was foggy.
hint: Doosra hissa ('the weather was foggy') train ke late hone ka karan (reason) bata raha hai.
explanation: Kisi ghatna ka karan (reason) batane ke liye conjunction 'because' (kyunki) ka use kiya jata hai.

question: Mona was absent _____ she was ill.
hint: Mona ke absent hone ka karan uski bimari ('she was ill') thi.
explanation: Karan (reason) batane wale clause ko jodne ke liye 'because' ka use hota hai.

question: We were getting late for the show _____ we take a taxi.
hint: Pehle hisse ka parinam (result) hai ki humne taxi li ('isliye humne taxi li').
explanation: Parinam (result) dikhane ke liye conjunction 'so' (isliye) ka use kiya jata hai.

question: No sooner did the teacher enter the class _____ the students stood up.
hint: 'No sooner' ke saath hamesha ek fixed pair conjunction aata hai.
explanation: 'No sooner' ke saath hamesha 'than' (t-h-a-n) ka pair banta hai, 'then' ya 'when' ka nahi.
